verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents bulk workflows for humans (bulk granting/signing contracts, bulk vesting schedule changes, HRIS sync for large data volumes, paginated API reads for cap table/transactions), suggesting some bulk capability exists, but there is no documented API/AI-native mechanism for bulk write operations (e.g., batch grant creation via API) — the only API operations listed are 'auth' and 'companyCaptable' (read-only), and no OpenAPI spec was discoverable. missing for 10: documented bulk-write API endpoints, evidence of programmatic/AI-agent-driven batch operations, an accessible OpenAPI schema confirming bulk operation support.
